low-relief figures aligned along a horizontal register
justification: Both surfaces show large-scale profile bearded men with tightly stylised, tiered curls of hair and beard, wearing patterned fringed robes and carrying objects, striding in the same direction along a horizontal relief register with animals also in profile, which is a fairly specific shared convention. The biggest difference in depicted content is that A shows composite winged supernatural beings (a raptor-headed, lion-bodied creature and a four-winged genie with weapons) in a confrontational two-panel scene, whereas B shows an ordinary file of tribute-bearers with vessels beside a camel beneath a rosette border, with no wings or hybrid creatures at all.
